original_test_intent: Execute one explicitly approved Manager.Reset action against the selected BMC manager, observe the bounded management outage, reconnect and verify manager plus host-management health without changing unrelated state.
original_method: Resolve the advertised action and supported ResetType, validate target/recovery/workload state, obtain OK, POST one exact payload, track response/task/outage, reconnect through an independent path and run post-reset health/configuration checks.
manual_activity: Approve POST as authoritative, target ManagerId, supported ResetType/payload, maintenance window, active-workload impact, maximum outage, reconnect path, health oracle and recovery procedure.
safety_requirements: Never PATCH or GET the action target as execution
No log clearing or credential exposure
agent_execution_scope: Read-only discover action/schema and pre-reset health
Capture redacted response or task URI
Reconnect and validate Manager resource, services and host-management visibility
engineer_actions: Resolve method conflict and approve reset contract

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: POST is the correct action method, but the source calls it PATCH and executes GET. DeepSeek supplies no exact payload and its generic unrelated-action/revert language is unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: POST exactly one advertised, supported ResetType payload after explicit OK, then observe bounded outage, reconnect and validate BMC/host management health; never auto-retry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Manager.Reset intent and 15/10 timing are preserved as source metadata; ResetType and real outage/recovery timing require approved firmware evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the reset as a one-shot disruptive action with external observation, deterministic reconnect and post-reset health validation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects both PATCH title and GET command to documented POST and adds all target, payload, outage and recovery gates.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Provides actual reset behavior; action metadata alone is covered by the adjacent discovery cases.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The management session will likely drop, monitoring may be interrupted and a timeout cannot reveal whether reset was accepted. Some manager resets can affect host management without powering off the host.

project_override_considerations: A vendor reset tool may replace raw POST only if it exposes the exact ResetType, one-shot semantics, task state and recovery evidence. Do not execute generic clear-log/media/network operations mentioned by DeepSeek.
expected_evidence: Approved method resolution and immutable target/firmware
Pre-reset BMC/host-management health and active-workload clearance
Exact payload hash plus redacted HTTP/task response
Unchanged unrelated configuration and preserved logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item says PATCH, the Procedure performs GET, while Manager.Reset semantics and the reference reviews require POST. These three methods are materially different; the review adopts POST only as a gated recommendation and preserves the Master conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The exact action schema, ResetType, approval and recovery package can resolve the operation safely, so the case is REQUIRES rather than irreducibly BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Resolves a three-way method mismatch into a documented one-shot POST reset with explicit outage, recovery and no-retry controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: Manager.Reset is modeled as an action, so PATCHing it is not configuration semantics and GETing it does not exercise reset. Once POST is selected, the main technical risk is loss of the same management channel used to observe success. External reachability and timed reconnect evidence are therefore more authoritative than the initiating connection. An absent response is ambiguous, so retries could issue multiple resets and must be prohibited.
